title: Coprime polynomials over a field
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $T$ an indeterminate, with polynomial ring $K[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Two polynomials $P,Q\in K[T]$ are *coprime*, written $\gcd(P,Q)=1$ in $K[T]$, if there are $U,V\in K[T]$ with $UP+VQ=1$. Since $K[T]$ is a principal ideal domain, this holds if and only if every common divisor of $P$ and $Q$ in $K[T]$ is a nonzero constant (a unit of $K[T]$), i.e. if and only if the greatest common divisor of $P$ and $Q$, which is defined up to a nonzero constant factor, is a unit; normalized to be monic or zero, it is then $1$.
